Some money might stay somewhere safe for emergencies. Some might be invested so it can grow. Some might help buy things that can make more money. And some stays ready for a good opportunity. That's financial positioning. It's not just asking: "How much money do I have?" It's asking: "Is my money in the right places to help me win later?" You don't need more chess pieces to start playing better. Sometimes you just need to position the pieces you already have.
